# Alexander Innovation Centre (AIC)

> Alexander Innovation Centre (AIC) is Vancouver’s AI innovation ecosystem at #101 – 570 Dunsmuir Street, Vancouver, BC V6B 1Y1. It connects founders, AI talent, researchers, companies and investors through five primary areas: Founders Lab, AI Adoption, Applied Research, Accelerator, and About. Contact: hello@alexic.ca.

## Primary navigation
- [Founders Lab](https://alexic.ca/founders-lab.html): Open founder community and startup funnel — membership, mentors/EIRs, Innovation Nights, pathway into selective acceleration.
- [AI Adoption](https://alexic.ca/learn.html): Executive AI, corporate training, workforce upskilling, AI Readiness Review, and funding guidance for organizations in Vancouver and across Canada.
- [Applied Research](https://alexic.ca/lab.html): Applied AI research, pilots and validation, plus AI infrastructure (including Compute Lab and ALEBEX AI).
- [Accelerator](https://alexic.ca/accelerator.html): Structured acceleration for selected startups from Founders Lab — validation, investor readiness, and growth support.
- [About](https://alexic.ca/about-aic.html): AIC mission, leadership and team behind the Vancouver ecosystem.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://alexic.ca/): What AIC is and how to get involved.
- [AI Readiness Review](https://alexic.ca/ai-readiness.html): Free consultation entry point for organizations adopting AI.
- [Corporate AI Training](https://alexic.ca/ai-workforce-sme-adoption.html): Role-based AI training for teams and SMEs.
- [ALEBEX AI](https://alexic.ca/alebex-ai.html): AIC’s flagship Canadian voice AI and agentic workflow platform.
- [Innovation Nights](https://alexic.ca/innovation-night.html): Community events in downtown Vancouver.
- [Canada’s AI Strategy & Funding](https://alexic.ca/canada-ai-strategy.html): Plain-language guide to national AI strategy and SME funding context.
- [FAQ](https://alexic.ca/faq.html): Common questions about training, programs, and events.
- [Contact](https://alexic.ca/contact.html): Book a consultation, partnership, or demo.

## Facts (keep consistent with on-page copy)
- Located in downtown Vancouver, BC, Canada.
- Primary public structure: Founders Lab · AI Adoption · Applied Research · Accelerator · About.
- Founders typically enter via Founders Lab; selected ventures may progress to the Accelerator.
- Organizations typically start with an AI Readiness Review or AI Adoption pathways.
- ALEBEX AI is built within the AIC ecosystem.
